description: This file defines a generic object pool class 'ObjectPool<T>' that manages reusable resources of type T, with support for concurrency, monitoring, and resource allocation strategies.

classes.name: ObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe, stack-based object pool managing reusable resources, with optional monitoring features.

methods.name: ObjectPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object pool with a factory function, optional monitor, and monitoring interval.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates and returns a resource from the pool, creating a new one if none are available.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns a resource to the pool for future reuse.

methods.name: ReportObjectPoolStatistics
methods.description: Reports current statistics of the object pool, including total, available, and claimed objects.
